{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Display the first few rows
top_rows = sales_df.head()

# Display the data types and missing values
dtypes_missing = sales_df.info()

# Display basic statistics
stats = sales_df.describe(include='all')

# Display unique values for categorical variables
categorical_cols = sales_df.select_dtypes(include=['object']).columns
unique_values = {col: sales_df[col].unique() for col in categorical_cols}

# Check for duplicates
duplicates = sales_df.duplicated().sum()

# Output all information
(top_rows, dtypes_missing, stats, unique_values, duplicates)"}
